title: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas
grouping: The whole gate sits in one large white rounded container with a light-grey outline; there are no sub-containers. The learned 1x1x1 transforms (W_g, W_x, psi) share one pale-blue fill with a blue outline; the fixed operations (ReLU, Sigmoid, Resampler) are white rounded squares with black outlines, named above the square.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes, no shadows. Each fixed nonlinearity is drawn as a white square holding a sketch of its curve (a ramp for ReLU, an S curve for sigmoid); the resampler is a small 3 x 4 grid icon. Addition and multiplication are circled + and x. Connectors are thin black orthogonal lines with hollow triangular arrowheads. Tensor shapes are italic math under each arrow (F_g x H_g x W_g x D_g, F_int x H_g W_g D_g, ...). The two inputs g and x^l enter from the left as labelled lines; x^l also runs as a long line along the bottom edge to the final multiplication.
proposed_highlight: The module is the whole figure. Learned parts are the only coloured boxes; the attention coefficient alpha and the gated output x-hat^l are named in math on the last arrows.
lesson: Draw each fixed nonlinearity as a white square holding a sketch of its curve (a ramp for ReLU, an S for sigmoid) and reserve the one tint for the learned 1x1x1 convolutions, so learned and fixed steps read apart without a legend.
notes: Venue from the PDF first page (MIDL 2018, Amsterdam).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: pancreas segmentation with attention gates in skip connections

insights.structure: A single horizontal pipeline inside one rounded light-grey frame: two parallel 1x1x1 convolutions W_g (top) and W_x (bottom) merge at a plus node, then ReLU, psi 1x1x1, Sigmoid, Resampler, and a multiply node producing x_hat^l.
insights.data: Each tensor edge carries its shape as italic text below it (F_g x H_g x W_g x D_g etc.), and the nonlinearities and resampler are drawn as glyph boxes (ramp, S-curve, grid).
insights.emphasis: Learnable convolutions are the only blue-filled boxes, while parameter-free steps are white glyph boxes, so trainable parts stand out.
insights.flow: Left-to-right with hollow-triangle arrowheads; a long skip line runs along the bottom from x^l to the final multiply node, closing the gating.
insights.avoid: Tensor shape labels in small italic math crowd under every edge and some lack the multiply signs, making them hard to read.

arrangement.units: one rounded frame with unenclosed blue (learned) and white glyph (fixed) boxes
arrangement.inputs_as: italic symbols g and x^l on incoming lines
arrangement.shared: x^l is used both as gate input and as the gated signal via a bottom skip
